topology.description: Adiabatic three-port directional coupler with gap-coupled waveguides
topology.function: Routes light from one input port among three output ports based on coupler strength
key_features: Two parallel waveguides with left taper region
Gap-coupled coupling region in the middle
Right expansion region where waveguides separate again

function_defining_knobs.wg_width_um: Waveguide width at entrance/exit (nominal ~0.5 μm for SOI)
function_defining_knobs.taper_width_min_um: Minimum waveguide width in coupling region (nominal ~0.1-0.2 μm)
function_defining_knobs.gap_um: Spacing between waveguide centerlines during coupling (nominal ~0.3-0.5 μm)
function_defining_knobs.coupler_length_um: Length of high-overlap coupling region (nominal ~10-15 μm)
function_defining_knobs.taper_length_um: Length of adiabatic S-bend taper on each side (nominal ~5-10 μm)

primitives_plan: Use gf.Path with extrude for S-bends (smooth tapering)
Parametric control of all key knobs via top-level tunables

iterations.change_made: Initial attempt: 3-waveguide model. Issue: target is 2-waveguide coupler, not 3-port. My device height 0.85 μm vs target 1.7 μm. Need to rethink topology.
2-waveguide coupler but rectangular tapers. Target has smooth S-bends. Height now correct (1.7 μm). Need curved paths instead of rectangles.
Switched to polygon-based linear tapers. Much better match. Target has curved S-bends, not linear. Next: adjust params and add curvature.
Added cubic spline curvature to tapers. Improved visual match but IoU dropped slightly. Reverted to linear.
Aggressive parameter tuning (min_width 0.16, coupler 19μm). Poor result. Reverted.
3-segment piecewise linear tapers (more detailed approximation). No improvement. Reached iteration limit.

final_summary.limiting_factor: Target image has smooth curved S-bends; my linear tapers are fundamentally different. To improve further would require Euler bend integration or real curve fitting.
